# Settings of a Talos document that Ichor's schema does not carry, one "Kind path" a line. Each is a
# setting of the v1alpha1 document that a document of its own spells; Ichor has the document's spelling, and
# the setting is written once. This file is read by TestEverySettingOfATalosDocumentHasAPlaceInTheSchema and
# is kept apart from the generator on purpose: a row that drops a setting there must also be written here.

# The version of the document is the one Ichor converts to.
Config version

# The document's own spelling (the settings of the document of the same meaning are in the schema).
